data.subject: Local Ledger weekly issue and pilot
data.body:
Hi,

Jacobs Asset Management's most recent 13F, for June 30, 2026, shows positions in MYFW, CBK, and AVBH.

On August 27, 2026, AVBH entered into a material definitive agreement, according to its Form 8-K Item 1.01 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1443575/000143774926029104/avbh20260429_8k.htm).

I can send the free weekly issue and outline a four-week fund pilot.

Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.

Andrew
